```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Verify that a patient generates a consultation request and the doctor sees it",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.2-5"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Patient and Doctor are registered users", "Patient generates a consultation request"],
    "inputs": {"requestId": "uniqueRequest123"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor accesses the consultation request system",
      "Doctor retrieves the request with ID 'uniqueRequest123'",
      "Doctor confirms the request is present and visible"
    ],
    "expected": ["Doctor sees the patient's consultation request"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Verify that the doctor gives a diagnosis after seeing the patient's consultation request",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.2-5"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doctor sees the patient's consultation request as in TC-001"],
    "inputs": {"requestId": "uniqueRequest123"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor formulates a diagnosis based on the patient's information",
      "Doctor submits the diagnosis to the system"
    ],
    "expected": ["System confirms the diagnosis submission"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",
    "title": "Verify that the prescription generated by the doctor is sent to the patient, chemist, and labs",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.2-6"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Doctor has given a diagnosis as in TC-002"],
    "inputs": {"diagnosisId": "diagnosis123"},
    "steps": [
      "Doctor sends the prescription to the patient",
      "Doctor sends the prescription to the chemist",
      "Doctor sends the prescription to the lab"
    ],
    "expected": ["Patient, chemist, and lab confirm receipt of the prescription"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Verify that the chemist delivers the medicines to the patient",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.2-7"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Prescription has been sent to the chemist as in TC-003"],
    "inputs": {"prescriptionId": "prescription123"},
    "steps": [
      "Chemist prepares the medicines",
      "Chemist delivers the medicines to the patient"
    ],
    "expected": ["Patient confirms receipt of the medicines"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-005",
    "title": "Verify that the chemist uses the prescription to collect specimen from the patient",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.2-7"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Prescription has been delivered to the patient as in TC-004"],
    "inputs": {"prescriptionId": "prescription123"},
    "steps": [
      "Chemist requests specimen collection from the patient",
      "Patient provides the specimen"
    ],
    "expected": ["Chemist confirms specimen collection"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",
    "title": "Verify that the lab delivers the lab report to the patient and updates the system",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.2-8"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Specimen has been collected by the lab as in TC-005"],
    "inputs": {"specimenId": "specimen123"},
    "steps": [
      "Lab processes the specimen",
      "Lab sends the lab report to the patient",
      "Lab updates the system with the lab report"
    ],
    "expected": ["Patient confirms receipt of the lab report", "System confirms the lab report update"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-007",
    "title": "Verify that the admin can set up specialties",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.3-1"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {"specialty": "General Medicine"},
    "steps": [
      "Admin accesses the specialties setup system",
      "Admin adds 'General Medicine' as a specialty"
    ],
    "expected": ["System confirms the addition of 'General Medicine'"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-008",
    "title": "Verify that the admin can add doctors",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.3-2"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {"doctorName": "Dr. Smith"},
    "steps": [
      "Admin adds 'Dr. Smith' as a doctor"
    ],
    "expected": ["System confirms the addition of 'Dr. Smith'"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-009",
    "title": "Verify that the admin can add labs",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.3-3"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": [],
    "inputs": {"labName": "LabCorp"},
    "steps": [
      "Admin adds 'LabCorp' as a lab"
    ],
    "expected": ["System confirms the addition of 'LabCorp'"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-100",
    "title": "Verify that the admin can edit doctor information",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.3-4"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Admin has added a doctor as in TC-008"],
    "inputs": {"doctorId": "doctorSmith", "newDetails": {"name": "Dr. Smith Updated", "contact": "updatedContact@example.com"}},
    "steps": [
      "Admin attempts to update 'Dr. Smith's' details with new information"
    ],
    "expected": ["System allows the update and confirms the change"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-101",
    "title": "Verify that the admin can delete a doctor",
    "req_ids": ["VIRTUA-2.3-4"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Admin has added a doctor as in TC-008"],
    "inputs": {"doctorId": "doctorSmith"},
    "steps": [
      "Admin attempts to delete 'Dr. Smith'"
    ],
    "expected": ["System confirms the deletion of 'Dr. Smith'"]
  }
]
```

Note: The above JSON test cases assume the use of a Python-based xUnit framework like pytest. The "preconditions" and "steps" fields are placeholders for the actual actions that need to be taken to set up the test environment. In a real-world scenario, these would involve more detailed setup steps, possibly including authentication, session management, and API calls. The "expected" fields are simplified and assume that the system will provide clear confirmation of each action. The "kind" field indicates whether the test is a positive case (expected to pass under normal conditions) or a negative case (expected to fail or throw an exception when incorrect inputs are provided). The negative tests for editing and deleting doctor information assume that the system should allow these actions, which may not always be the case depending on the system's permissions and logic. Adjustments may be needed based on the actual system behavior and requirements.

Remember to replace placeholders with actual system-specific details and implement the necessary mocks or stubs to simulate the system's behavior for each step. The test suite should be executed in an environment where the system under test is accessible, and the necessary permissions are granted.
